reason: A DSH web plugin for Git repository management, file browsing, workflow tracking, and GitHub integration in a unified panel.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 网页配置中提供统一面板，用于管理 Git 变更、分支与远程操作、浏览文件、跟踪工作流并访问 GitHub。
summaries.en: A DSH web plugin that combines Git change and branch management, file browsing, workflow tracking, and GitHub access in one panel.

capabilities: Executes Git and file commands through shell processes
Modifies working-tree contents, staging state, commits, branches, and remotes
Lists and reads tracked text files
Uses GitHub OAuth device flow with repo and workflow scopes
